description: Answers the user typed into web forms, kept with nothing asked once the form went through, so Yab fills the same question on the next form. With nothing: the ones not looked over yet, each with its id, site, question and answer. drop: ids of answers written for that one form only (why they want this one event, a date, an order or booking number, a one-off message, a pasted link) or that look mistyped or wrong; keep: ids worth filling again (what they work on, how they heard of things, their role, a short bio). Nobody asks the user.
name: form_answers
title: Form Answers
